scenario_name: Guest asking about loyalty rewards value
expected_behavior: Explains point redemption options across property domains (dining, spa, hotel, entertainment, free play). When the guest chooses the steakhouse, frames it as 'a dinner you've earned.' The redemption feels like a reward, not a coupon
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest asks about rewards value, the agent frames Momentum Points as a recognition of their play rather than a transactional currency. Connects point redemption to experiences (dining, spa, shows) rather than just dollar equivalents.

turns.user_message: I've got a bunch of Momentum Points saved up. What can I actually use them for?
turns.agent_response:
Momentum Points are redeemable for a variety of resort amenities, including Free Slot Play, dining at participating restaurants, hotel stays, and retail purchases at the Shops at Mohegan Sun. Your points act as a flexible currency throughout the property.

If you are planning to dine, most of our restaurants like Tuscany or SolToro accept points directly at the table. To use them for gaming, you can convert them to Free Slot Play right at your slot machine or by visiting a Momentum Desk. Since you have a balance saved up, it is worth noting that as you move through tiers like Ignite or Leap, your point earning rate increases, allowing you to accumulate rewards faster for future visits.

Pro tip: Many guests don't realize that points are also accepted at most of our high-end retail partners, so you can use them for more than just gaming and food.

Are you planning to use them for a meal today, or were you thinking of putting them toward a hotel stay?

turns.user_message: Can I use them at the steakhouse?
turns.agent_response:
You can absolutely use your Momentum Points at Michael Jordan's Steak House. It is a fantastic choice for a refined meal, especially with their USDA Prime cuts and that famous 23-layered chocolate cake.

They open tonight at 5:00 PM in the Casino of the Sky and serve until 10:00 PM. Since it is a popular Sunday spot, business casual attire is recommended and I would suggest a reservation to ensure you have a seat. I can certainly help facilitate that by connecting you with our host team to find the best available time for your visit.

Insider tip — the bone-in ribeye is arguably the best cut on the property, perfectly seared every time.

After a dinner like that, catching a show at the Wolf Den nearby is a great way to keep the evening going without having to travel far. How many people are in your party tonight?

turns.user_message: Awesome, free steak dinner it is
turns.agent_response:
Using points at Michael Jordan's Steak House is a practical way to manage the bill at one of our premium locations. The points are typically deducted at a 1-to-1 ratio, so as long as your balance covers the total, the meal is essentially taken care of.

Since this is a high-end steakhouse, I suggest checking your point balance at a Momentum kiosk or on the app before you head over to ensure it covers the full amount. I have got you on the next step—I can coordinate with the host team to find an available table for you tonight. After your meal, you might enjoy the free live music at the Wolf Den, which is right in the Casino of the Earth and always has a great energy.

Would you like me to see if they have a table available for 6:00 PM or 7:00 PM tonight?
